newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end down on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end down on profit-taking.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished lower on Wednesday amid profit-taking by small investors but dealers said covering of short positions before the Friday-Saturday weekend could push the index up on Thursday.
"Buying in textile stocks will continue while individuals who are short will cover their positions ahead of the weekend," dealer Ali Raza Mooney said.

The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) 100-share index fell 13.77 points, or 0.92 percent, to end at 1,476.23. Losers led gainers 189 to 115. Turnover fell to 41.11 million shares from 43.57 million on Tuesday.
Hub Power Co was steady at 35.15. PTCL fell 0.30 to 30.70 and Fauji Fertilizer 1.35 to 76.15. ICI Pakistan rose 0.15 to 17.50 and Searle Pakistan 5.75 to 38.
Fazal Textile fell 1.50 to 25 and Gadoon Textile 0.50 to 38. Hajra Textile rose 2.0 to 6.0.
